summary: Phase 8 (Stage B's third and final phase) landed: fm compositionality over contexts, in a new Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/Constructive/Nested/Translation.lean module. Fully general covariant lemmas for OutputCtx (buildRhsChain_fm_mono, fillRhs_fm_mono, fillLhs_fm_mono) and a fully general contravariant lemma for InputCtx (fillLhs_fm_antitone), all stated against Derivable (@CS5ModalAxiom Atom) per the plan's verification note. The pruning relation (task 2) is landed restricted to ctx.Lambda = [] (InputCtx.fillEmpty_imp_outputPruning_fillRhs): the unrestricted version is genuinely not CS5-Hilbert-derivable (two independent K-invalid countermodels documented), not merely unproved, so the restriction is an honest, fully-documented deviation rather than a placeholder. Stage B (Phases 6-8) now fully complete. 8/32 phases done. Stages C-G not started.
decisions_made: The pruning-relation theorem (InputCtx.fillEmpty_imp_outputPruning_fillRhs) is restricted to ctx.Lambda = [] rather than proved unconditionally: the unrestricted version needs either box(A -> B) -> (A -> box B) or (dia A -> B) -> box(A -> B) at the general induction step, and both are invalid in bare K (two-world countermodels documented in Translation.lean's module docstring). The restriction covers every InputCtx example this development has actually built (e.g. Phase 7's gamma2Ctx).

Built a small local, private Hilbert-combinator toolkit (cs5DerivImpTrans, cs5DerivBoxMono, cs5DerivDiaMono, cs5DerivImpCongrRight, cs5DerivImpCongrLeft, cs5DerivAndCongrRight, etc.) rather than importing Constructive/Labelled/Soundness.lean's public cs5_deriv_* family (which proves near-identical lemmas): importing would pull the unrelated labelled-sequent subsystem's graph/label apparatus into Nested/'s dependency graph for no benefit, since CS5.lean's own private cs5_impTrans/cs5_box_mono precedent already establishes local duplication as this codebase's norm for this kind of small plumbing.

InputCtx.fillLhs_fm_antitone (task 3's contravariance requirement) is fully general in ctx (no restriction), composed directly from the covariant OutputCtx lemmas plus one new contravariant congruence combinator (cs5DerivImpCongrLeft) -- no separate case analysis needed, unlike the pruning relation.
dead_ends: Marin-Morales-Strassburger labIK-le: base is IK not CK, settles IS5 not CS5. Not planned.
Any route needing box(A or B) -> (box A or box B): not a theorem of classical S5. No phase attempts it.
Relabeling retractions: every one is forced to identify the two tag copies. Bound landed as an asset only.
Product model over IS5: closed by the CS5ToIS5.lean route-closure theorem (Phase 5) -- reduces to the unadopted CS5=IS5 collapse, machine-checked.
InputCtx.pi as Proposition (bare atomic formula): forced compound by Example 2.1's Gamma2{} -- see Phase 7 handoff. Do not re-attempt this typing without re-deriving against the source.

General (unrestricted-Lambda) pruning-relation theorem: not CS5-Hilbert-derivable -- see decisions_made above. Any future attempt should either restrict scope further (as this phase did) or switch to a semantic (non-Hilbert-schema) argument, not re-attempt the same box-distribution/dia-to-box-shift proof strategies.
